changes.description: Reminder confirmation and error messages are now standardized — same wording every time, whether set via /reminder or by talking to the bot
Steam observer no longer floods the channel with notifications when a private profile becomes public
Long gaps in Steam profile visibility (1 month+) are re-synced silently instead of notifying about every game accumulated during that time
Bot no longer sends duplicate replies when multiple AI features could respond to the same message or DM
Centralized message routing for chat/DM AI features — cleaner, more consistent handling as more features are added
Human must be enabled for any AI-driven @mention feature to respond on a server
Typing indicator now shows while the bot processes a chat or DM reminder request
Reminder notification embed styling unified with the rest of the bot
Reminders module — schedule one-off reminders for yourself
/reminder create, list, and cancel commands — usable in servers and DMs
Ask the bot in chat or DM to set or cancel a reminder in natural language
Reminders are delivered back to wherever they were created — DM or server channel
/changelog command — view bot version history
FitCoach — meal & nutrition tracking module (AI-powered)
Meal logging via DM chat, photos, and /meal add
Nutrition lookup against Open Food Facts & USDA databases
AI estimation for ingredients not found in any database
Meal time ranges and timezone configuration via interactive modals
Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly nutrition summaries
Day summary includes AI-generated nutrition insight
Ask AI in chat to show meal list or summary for any period
Onboarding flow with default or custom meal time presets
Max message character size handling for all embeds
Saved messages search function
Context and tool usage tweaks for AI
Function calling to retrieve conversation context
Configurable context size for humanized module
Steam integration — new game release notifications
Humanized module — AI responds as a human in configured channels

Guild management commands

Better context handling and image compression for AI

Good morning command now triggers on startsWith
